categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai Hajime Advanced Material Technology Co., Ltd. specializes in the R&D, production, and sales of precision injection molded parts and matching precision injection molds. Its products primarily serve the automotive sector (including passenger cars, commercial vehicles, and new energy vehicles) and high-end home appliances, with expanding applications in humanoid robots, energy storage, aerospace, industrial, and medical fields.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company focuses on special engineering plastics and precision injection molding technology, including custom mold design and development. It employs advanced manufacturing processes integrating materials, molds, equipment, and quality control, with proprietary technologies such as vacuum suction, in-mold shear, hot runner application, and thread twisting. The production model is 'make-to-order' with customized mold development preceding mass production.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading global automotive parts suppliers (e.g., Sanhua Intelligent Controls, Aisin, Pierburg, Schaeffler, Autoliv, Magna) and renowned home appliance manufacturers (e.g., A.O. Smith, Panasonic, Kohler, Noritz, TOTO). The main markets are automotive (including new energy vehicles) and high-end home appliances, with growing penetration into humanoid robots, energy storage, aerospace, and industrial sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with headquarters and production facilities in Shanghai and subsidiaries in Hunan, Chongqing, and Singapore. It serves domestic and international markets, with export sales accounting for approximately 10.87% of revenue. The company is expanding overseas production capacity, including investment in Mexico.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shanghai Hajime operates primarily as a midstream manufacturer and supplier of precision plastic components and molds, serving as a tier-2 supplier to automotive OEMs and tier-1 suppliers, as well as a direct supplier to home appliance manufacturers. It is positioned upstream of final assembly but downstream of raw material suppliers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes value innovation through product and technology development, focusing on high-value, complex, and reliable precision injection molded parts. R&D priorities include new energy vehicle components (thermal management modules, electronic pumps, sensors), humanoid robot parts, and high-end home appliance components. It invests in advanced equipment, digital factory construction, and talent development to enhance innovation and production efficiency.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of customized precision injection molded parts and molds. The company signs framework agreements with customers and recognizes revenue upon delivery and customer acceptance. It also earns income from government subsidies and investment returns on financial assets.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes in a fragmented plastic parts industry with many small and medium enterprises but has established a strong position through technological capabilities, quality, and stable relationships with leading automotive and home appliance companies. It is recognized as a high-quality domestic supplier capable of replacing imported high-end precision plastic parts.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 755.9 million, a 27.86% increase over 2023, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 141.8 million, up 37.25%. It maintains steady asset growth with total assets around RMB 1.37 billion. The company has shown consistent growth driven by expanding orders, especially in new energy vehicle components.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shanghai Hajime offers high-precision, high-quality engineering plastic parts that replace traditional metal components ('plastic instead of steel/copper'), contributing to automotive lightweighting and energy efficiency. Its competitive advantages include advanced mold design and manufacturing, stringent quality control, customized solutions, and strong customer collaboration, enabling it to meet stringent safety, durability, and performance requirements in automotive and home appliance applications.
